units.source_text: 有办法可以一眼就分辨出哪一种类型的女人喜欢X型腿哩。

en.t: There is a way to tell at a glance what kind of woman likes bowlegs.

units.source_text: 这种女人多半是无与伦比的美人，鼻尖而冷漠，嘴边却露出几分轻佻……"

en.t: Women like that are usually beauties beyond compare, with sharp, cold noses, yet a hint of frivolity showing around their mouths..."
